primitives.name: Attribute Hierarchy Decomposition
primitives.verbatim_quote: And there is a hierarchy of attributes 1 in order of generality down to the slight peculiarities which probably distinguish in some manner and degree (other than mere situation) every nameable thing in the universe from every other, giving it individuality.
primitives.assumptions: Universal individuation through hierarchical attribute nesting.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Hierarchical feature importance quantification. GSE: State-action branching factor reduction via attribute-based pruning.
layer2.telemetry: Dimensionality reduction efficacy on multi-scale feature sets.

primitives.name: Consciousness Postulate
primitives.verbatim_quote: The postulates of intelligent behavior would be very incomplete without formal insistence on the rôle played by the fact of consciousness in ""objects" outside ourselves, human beings and animals.
primitives.assumptions: Non-trivial external states possess internal representational capacity.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Incorporates agent-model uncertainty. GSE: Models opponent theory-of-mind via state-transition observation.
layer2.telemetry: Performance degradation when treating opponents as black boxes.

primitives.name: Humean Skepticism Rejection
primitives.verbatim_quote: It is always possible for the scientist to argue the contrary, as it is for him to demonstrate that we are not really conscious ourselves, but common sense properly revolts against the one conclusion as against the other.
primitives.assumptions: External reality and self-consciousness are simultaneously true.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Rejects radical probabilistic updating without empirical anchor. GSE: Maintains deterministic core amidst stochastic noise.
layer2.telemetry: Consistency metrics on sequential decision-making under uncertainty.

Humean Skepticism Rejection enforces a minimal empirical realism—models must have grounding in observable phenomena rather than being purely epistemically hollow. Together, these operators enable the construction of robust, interpretable decision-theoretic frameworks that can be systematically calibrated against real-world telemetry.
